definition: Śiva's autonomy-power (svasvātantryaśakti), by which he is conscious of himself. Synonymous with Śakti = I-consciousness. Not a physical vibration but a movement in the space of Consciousness. The Power of Śiva by which He manifests, maintains, and withdraws the entire universe.
rasa: adbhuta (wonder at unmeasured greatness) resolving into śānta (tranquility of self-established nature)

sources.claim: spanda = Śiva's self-aware autonomy; the world arises as his play without disturbing his self-established nature
Spanda is synonymous with Śakti (I-consciousness); Spanda is the Power of Śiva by which He is conscious of Himself
Spanda is the Power of Śiva — the dynamic aspect of consciousness
Spanda is the Supreme Power of Śiva. She has countless names: Parāśakti, Pūrṇāhantā, Citi, Mahāhrada, Parāvāk and so on.

translations.note: No English equivalent; 'throb' carries physical connotations that mislead. Use 'autonomy-power' or 'self-aware throb' in technical contexts. Gold reference: sanskrit-trikashaivism.com Trika Glossary (sibilants section).
